subject.title: support international model studio for alibaba token plan

question: Should CodexBar support the reported international Alibaba Token Plan as a supported regional variant once a redacted live API shape is available, or keep the provider limited to the currently verified plan variants?
rationale: The report requests a new regional support commitment, while the available related issue suggests an international endpoint may already exist for a different plan variant; maintainer intent is needed to define the supported compatibility boundary.

options.title: Validate and support the variant
options.body: Request a redacted international subscribed-account capture, then add the narrow host/response variant if it fits the existing provider contract.

options.title: Keep verified variants only
options.body: Document that only currently verified Alibaba plan variants are supported until reproducible international API evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Validate and support the variant
recommendation.body: Request a redacted international subscribed-account capture, then add the narrow host/response variant if it fits the existing provider contract.
